row.logsLabel: Open the logs of the preview for pull request {{number}}

approve.title: Approve preview for PR #{{number}}?
approve.fromRepo: This pull request comes from {{repo}}, not from this app's own repository.
approve.warning: Approving runs the fork's code on your server. Read the changes first. Only this commit deploys; a new push from the fork waits for approval again.
approve.shareSecrets: Also give it this app's environment variables and secrets
approve.shareSecretsHint: Off by default. Turn this on only if you trust the author: the code can read and send out every value.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle, resources and exposure
lifecycle.description: How many previews an app keeps, how big they are, what data they can reach, and who can see them.
lifecycle.unavailable: Preview settings are not available on this control plane.
lifecycle.maxPreviews: Most live previews for this app
lifecycle.memoryHint: Platform default is {{value}}. A preview never gets more than the app itself has.
lifecycle.idleHint: 0 uses the platform default ({{value}} minutes). A sleeping preview wakes on the next request.

database.label: Database
database.hint: A preview never connects to production data unless you choose shared.
database.none: None: no database credentials reach the preview
database.fresh: Fresh: an empty database of the same engine
database.seed: Seed: a copy of a named database's latest backup
database.seedHint: Empty uses the database attached to the app.
database.sharedWarning: Every preview, including unreviewed branches, can read and change production data.

exposure.heading: Who can see previews
exposure.forkSecrets: Give fork previews the app's environment and secrets
exposure.forkSecretsHint: Off by default. A fork preview gets no environment variables at all.
exposure.forkSecretsWarning: Anyone who can open a pull request from a fork can run code that reads these values.
exposure.indexing: Let search engines index preview URLs
exposure.indexingHint: Off by default: previews send X-Robots-Tag noindex and serve a deny-all robots.txt.
exposure.gateHint: One username and password for every preview of this app.
exposure.gatePasswordSet: A password is set. Leave blank to keep it.
exposure.gateNeedsPassword: Set a username and a password to turn the gate on.
